title: FREE prompt to make Claude Smarter
description:
You've been writing half a prompt.

The half that says no is missing.

Every prompt is a wish list.

More context, more instructions.

But look at your worst outputs.

You never asked for any of it.

It rewrote files you didn't mention.

It guessed instead of asking.

It built a system for a one-liner.

That's not a skill gap.

That's eagerness.

You can't fix eagerness by adding.

You fix it by removing.

One file. Four boundaries.

Write less, follow the prompt, check the work.

Like a new hire who never stops to ask.

The fix was never more training.

Smarter didn't mean more here.

It meant knowing when to stop.

Drop the file in and watch.

#claude #github #ai #prompting #coding
